tei:editionStmt.tei:p: Expanded Ashkenazi siddur: prayers in recitation order. Prayer words are transcluded from their source editions. Birnbaum supplies selected High Holiday services and rites, not a complete mahzor.

tei:sourceDesc.tei:bibl: This project arranges prayer text from Birnbaum 1949 and readings from the Humash and Tanakh editions. See the project index for the editorial arrangement.

j:conditional.tei:note: Between Rosh Hashanah and Yom Kippur and on fast days:

Taḥanun is recited on weekday afternoons, except on Fridays and the following occasions: Erev Rosh Ḥodesh and Rosh Ḥodesh, the entire month of Nisan, the day preceding Lag b’Omer and Lag b’Omer, the first eight days of Sivan, the 8th, 9th, 14th and 15th of Av, from Erev Yom Kippur until the second day after Sukkoth, from the 24th of Kislev until after Ḥanukkah, the 14th and 15th of Shevat, the 13th, 14th and 15th of Adar and Adar Sheni. Taḥanun is also omitted in the house of a mourner during the week of mourning, and on the occasion of a Brith Milah.
